sections: Deterministic canonical bytes, renderer, and lifecycle
Global authority lock order and retained observations

repo_truth: Lifecycle state evaluation and atomic promotion transaction primitives are present. This lane owns new lifecycle persistence and promotion-record builder modules/tests only.
allowed_scope: Consume existing lifecycle evaluator, lineage store, registry observation, and promotion transaction APIs without editing their owning modules.
Coordinate additive lib.rs exports with parent; do not edit compiler/CLI/flow/docs.
non_goals: Do not implement authenticator approval or registry mutations.
Do not mutate truth from lifecycle events or auto-regenerate a Charter.
Do not commit or write handoffs/ledger/proof/control.
tasks: Implement immutable lifecycle observations/transitions, state fingerprints, trigger evidence resolution, standalone lock/journal/recovery, precedence, idempotence, and targeted reopen mappings.

Implement caller-intent-only promotion service that re-reads candidate content, approvals, registry pair, definitions, current canonical/lifecycle state; builds exact promotion and clearance lifecycle records; calls atomic promotion transaction.
Test total transition/recovery tables, marker exactness, stale/unknown/replayed events, incomplete clearance, create/amend basis, approval/quorum order, and one authority commit.
contracts_and_gates: Standalone lifecycle events never change canonical truth.
Clearance requires valid new approved lineage and addresses all active observations.
Promotion builder constructs semantic records entirely in engine and re-resolves all retained dependencies.
Global lock order and recovery-before-observation are exact.
stop_conditions: Stop before HIGH/CRITICAL existing-symbol edits and report blast radius.
Return blocked rather than weaken transaction/lifecycle authority or enter HCM-2.3.
